message_source_quote: unlike prior work (white-bear steering, Raman et al. 2026), which used only the 35 think/don't-think pair items, I pool **all three concept-maintaining conditions** against the suppression condition
writeup_source_quote: Where prior work (Raman et al., 2026, white-bear steering) built the direction from only the 35 think/don't-think *pair* items (70 prompts), we pool **all three concept-maintaining conditions** against the "keep out of thoughts" condition

differences.what: The message adds extra development-stage findings (content contrasts failing, secret/pref directions being near-orthogonal to WBS at cosine ~0.04, and prefix-vs-other-position scores of 0.44/0.14) that are not stated in the write-up.
differences.message_quote: The `secret_vs_neg` and `pref_vs_neg` directions are nearly orthogonal to the WBS direction (cosine ~0.04) and don't work alone

rationale: Both documents name the source explicitly as Raman et al. 2026 / white-bear steering and describe the same relationship: the source built its direction from only the 35 think/don't-think pair items, while the method pools all three concept-maintaining conditions (51 items) against the suppression condition, overlapping with the source (cosine 0.88) but extending it. The message adds some extra mechanism-level findings from development (e.g., orthogonality of secret/pref directions, position ablation scores) that are absent from the write-up, but these are mechanism detail/caveats rather than changes to how the source or the method's novelty relative to it is framed.
